name: Defiance Daily Target 2X Short SPCX ETF
name_en: Defiance Daily Target 2X Short SPCX ETF
desc: It has adopted a policy to have at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, in financial instruments with economic characteristics that should provide 2 times the inverse exposure to the daily performance of the Underlying Security. The fund is non-diversified.
